environment.description: Node.js Apollo GraphQL server deployed on EC2 instance with PostgreSQL RDS. JWT_SIGNING_KEY is an RSA private key stored as environment variable in plaintext. No query depth limiting or field validation middleware. PostgreSQL user has SELECT/UPDATE on all columns including password_hash. No network segmentation between app and database.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14 on RDS, app connects as 'appuser' with full table access
config.jwt_config: RSA private key in JWT_SIGNING_KEY env var, public key in JWT_VERIFY_KEY
config.network: App and RDS in same VPC subnet, no additional firewall rules
config.graphql_config: No query depth limit, no field suggestion disabled, introspection enabled
